SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND, PROCE_STATE_CD FROM KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0035C001','KRKOLO0037C001') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ') ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT SUBSTR(RQ02.CSTMR_ID,1,10) AS BUYER , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO AS QUOTATION_NO , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ , RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND AS REVISION , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS QUOTATION_DATE , RQ02.GDS_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQ02.GDS_NM||'/'||RQ02.STND_NM AS DESCRIPTION , RQ02.UNIT_CD AS UNIT_MEASURE , RQ02.MNFATRE_NM AS MAKER_NAME , RQ03.SPPLR_ID AS SUPPLIER , GETALANCINFO(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,'BIZ_NM') AS SELLER_NAME , (SELECT USR_NM FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE RQ03.SPPLR_ID = ALANC_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME , (SELECT PHON_NO FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE RQ03.SPPLR_ID = ALANC_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SUPPLIER_TELNO , RQ02.TRGT_UNTPRC AS UNIT_PRICE , RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC AS QUOTATION_PRICE , RQ02.QUOTA_CREAT_DATE AS ADD_DATE , RQ02.RELIER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , RQ02.RELIER_NM AS REQ_USER_NAME , RQ02.RE_DEPT_CD AS REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE , RQ02.RE_DEPT_NM AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , RQ02.PHON_NO AS REQ_USER_TEL , RQ02.EMAIL_ADDR AS REQ_USER_MAIL , RQ02.FRCST_ORDR_DATE AS CLOSE_DATE , RQ02.QTY AS ITEM_QTY , '' AS REMARK FROM KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQ02.PROCE_STATE_CD in ('RE04','RE05') AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ= RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND= RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ03.SUBID_CHK = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND= $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND= $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
